column7: k8s-sync and the operator registered -metrics-bearer-token with default os.Getenv("KEYORIX_METRICS_TOKEN"); flag usage output (on -h and on any unknown/malformed flag) prints non-empty defaults, so a typo in the container args put the metrics token in the pod log. Both now register an empty default and read the variable after parsing (flagOrEnv). Operator half: operator/cmd TestMain_UsageNeverPrintsMetricsToken (separate module). Class guard: semgrep keyorix-secret-env-as-flag-default (blocking keyorix-rules job). Found by SECRETENV-REVIEW-1.
